mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS student_id, u.real_name, u.username FROM student_course sc JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = sc.student_id WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId}
ORDER BY u.id

SELECT sc.student_id AS student_id, MAX(ar.answered_at) AS last_answer_at, COALESCE(SUM(ar.answered_at >= #{since7}), 0) AS answers7, COALESCE(SUM(ar.answered_at >= #{since7} AND ar.is_correct = 0), 0) AS wrong7, COALESCE(SUM(ar.answered_at >= #{since14}), 0) AS answers14, COALESCE(SUM(ar.answered_at >= #{since14} AND ar.is_correct = 1), 0) AS correct14 FROM student_course sc LEFT JOIN answer_record ar ON ar.student_id = sc.student_id AND ar.course_id = sc.course_id AND ar.is_correct IS NOT NULL WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId}
GROUP BY sc.student_id

SELECT s.student_id, s.course_id, s.node_id, s.mastery_score, s.mastery_level, s.snapshot_at AS updated_at FROM mastery_snapshot s JOIN ( SELECT ms.student_id, ms.node_id, MAX(ms.id) AS mid FROM student_course sc JOIN mastery_snapshot ms ON ms.student_id = sc.student_id AND ms.course_id = sc.course_id WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId}
AND ms.snapshot_at <= #{cutoff} GROUP BY ms.student_id, ms.node_id ) t ON t.mid = s.id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ar.answered_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS answers, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.student_id) AS active_students FROM student_course sc JOIN answer_record ar ON ar.student_id = sc.student_id AND ar.course_id = sc.course_id WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId}
AND ar.answered_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ar.answered_at, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT m.conversation_id) AS conversations FROM student_course sc JOIN companion_conversation c ON c.student_id = sc.student_id AND c.course_id = sc.course_id JOIN companion_message m ON m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.role = 1 AND m.created_at >= #{since} WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT ar.question_id AS question_id, ar.student_answer AS student_answer, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student_course sc JOIN answer_record ar ON ar.student_id = sc.student_id AND ar.course_id = sc.course_id WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId}
AND ar.answered_at >= #{since} AND ar.is_correct IS NOT NULL AND ar.question_id IN #{qid} GROUP BY ar.question_id, ar.student_answer

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.conversation_id) FROM student_course sc JOIN companion_conversation c ON c.student_id = sc.student_id AND c.course_id = sc.course_id JOIN companion_message m ON m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.role = 1 AND m.created_at >= #{from} AND m.created_at < #{to} WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId}
